launch: real generator action creates a random draft URL and an exact snapshot
migration: database 1 → 3 retains sessions and adds drafts/settings/presets-local and session indexes
reload: direct address with no history restores identical questions and renews lastOpenedAt
session: collective voting phase resumes without revealing answers

retention: 24 hours after last opening; expired drafts removed, unknown schemas and invalid dates preserved
invalidLinks: clear error and generator link; stale history cannot bypass the stored record

unavailableStorage: generator-to-game handoff remains playable in the current tab, with a visible warning

images: only image references persist; inline bytes use the current-tab handoff
snapshot: later changes to the source object cannot change the stored draft
